About Clouditech

Direct expertise. Long-term accountability.

Clouditech is an Azure managed services provider based in Makati City, helping startups and growing businesses build and operate cloud environments with fewer surprises.

Why we exist

Growing teams need a cloud platform that is secure, affordable, and easy to change, but they rarely have a dedicated platform team to build and run it.

Clouditech fills that gap. We combine hands-on architecture and automation experience with a practical understanding of operations, security, and cost, and we stay accountable after go-live.

Engagements are led by Lloyd Christian Ismael, so you always work directly with a senior engineer.

Hands-on cloud and IT engineering
9+ years
Philippines-based, supporting remote clients

How we work with you

Direct expertise

Engagements are founder-led. The person scoping your work is the person building it.

Transparent by design

Infrastructure, pipelines, and decisions are documented and versioned, so you are never locked in.

Long-term accountability

We stay after launch to monitor, maintain, and improve the platform as your business changes.
